answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond, stamped like a ferrous seal, before its answer is written to the ledger. Honest, peer-attested work returns the bond; an answer the jury rejects is slashed. Each saffron-fresh identity you spin up must lock its own capital up front, so a thousand clones mean a thousand bonds genuinely at risk, not one shared stake. The quill that signs junk forfeits coin, making sybil farming cost real money per fake instead of being free to replicate.
